subject: ela
cluster: Range of Reading and Level of Text Complexity
intro: Read each informational passage and pick the answer.

items.prompt:
Read.

The heart's four chambers pump blood.

How many chambers?
A) Two
B) Four
C) Six

Read.

The author argues for conserving water.

Purpose:
A) persuade
B) entertain
C) confuse

'As a physician of 40 years, I assure you...' appeals to:
A) ethos (credibility)
B) pathos only
C) rhyme

Read.

The assembly line made goods cheap and abundant but reduced skilled craftsmen to interchangeable laborers.

Two central ideas are:
A) cheap abundance and the de-skilling of labor
B) only that lines are fast
C) only that goods are nice
items.answer: A) cheap abundance and the de-skilling of labor

steps: Two interacting ideas. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) cheap abundance and the de-skilling of labor

items.prompt:
'We did not inherit the earth; we borrow it from our children' gains its force from:
A) a striking reversal/metaphor
B) a dry statistic
C) a definition

Read.

The study notes its tiny sample and urges caution.

The conclusion should be treated as:
A) uncertain/tentative
B) fully proven
C) irrelevant

Read.

'Either we save the forests now or lose everything.'

This reasoning is weak because it is a:
A) false dilemma (ignores other options)
B) valid statistic
C) peer-reviewed study

steps: Only two options. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Read.

The treaty ended the war but imposed harsh terms that bred resentment and a later conflict.

Which is BEST supported?
A) The treaty brought peace yet planted the seeds of future war
B) The treaty had no effects
C) Treaties never matter
items.answer: A) The treaty brought peace yet planted the seeds of future war

steps: Two interacting ideas. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) The treaty brought peace yet planted the seeds of future war
